title: "We are a library, not a shop": an interview with Thornwood's seed keeper
text: We opened in 2014 with about a dozen varieties in a filing cabinet, and we are up to somewhere over forty now. Everything happens in Ashgrove; we have never had a second site. The dues cover the paper and the packets, and the grant covers the rest. The swap in spring is the one day of the year when everybody turns up. There are two of us on the payroll and perhaps thirty volunteers across a year.
notes: Set A. First-person interview, so facts arrive as speech rather than statement.
